messages:
maria: Planned tenant backfill for user_preferences tonight 03:00 UTC. Long run (est 3-4h). Request: pin deploybot to schema-v2.13.4 for the migration and run partitioned job. Ack/concerns?
ryan: Ack. Which shard ranges and any locking expectations?
maria: Shards 2000-4999. We'll do chunked updates, expect short exclusive locks during index rebuilds only. Running low concurrency (concurrency=2).
```bash
# backfill job
./run_backfill --table=user_preferences --shard-range=2000-4999 \\  --chunk-size=10000 --concurrency=2 --dry-run=false
```
sam: If deploybot can't pin automatically, what's the fallback?
maria: Fallback is to abort the backfill and flip feature flag 'pref_backfill_enabled' -> off. Manual unpin as escalation: @leah can you stand by for manual unpin? :pray: 
leah: :thumbsup: I can manual-unpin. I'll be on call during the window.
deploybot: schedule accepted. Pinning schema-v2.13.4 for release-group 'tenant-backfills' at 1769807777. Will emit progress every 15m and alert on latency threshold >200ms.
opsbot: heads-up: please add a short release note about possible transient spikes. Added draft to release_notes/1769807777.md: "user_preferences backfill (partitioned). Transient index rebuilds may cause 1-2s latency spikes."
ryan: Abort criteria proposal: if p99 DB latency >300ms sustained for >10m -> stop backfill. Agree?
maria: Agree. Also add: if row lock count >5 sustained >5m -> stop. We'll run shard-level smoke checks after each shard completes.
sam: Preparing rollback runbook now, will paste relevant snippets.
sam: ```sql
-- rollback snippet
UPDATE feature_flags SET value='off' WHERE key='pref_backfill_enabled';
SELECT count(*) FROM backfill_jobs WHERE status IN ('running','queued');
```
maria: Thanks. Final ops ask: disable canary for us-west-2 and pin to schema-v2.13.4. I'll kick the backfill at 03:05 UTC to give a 5m buffer after window opens.
deploybot: Canary disabled for us-west-2, pinned to schema-v2.13.4, scheduled start 03:05 UTC. Will post deployment events and progress updates to this thread.
leah: On call and monitoring. DM me immediately if we hit abort criteria.
